verdict.rationale: llama.cpp's CLI/server clearly support GPU offload (community reports of setting N_GPU_LAYERS and CPU+GPU hybrid splitting) and general CLI invocation (llama cli -hf, llama serve -hf), but the evidence pack never shows a concrete example of a context-length flag or a single command combining both settings. missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of a context-length CLI flag, and a combined example showing both GPU offload and context length set together.
